sourceCandidates.title: Vetto — Data is an interface
Graphene Ventures portfolio: Vetto

observationCandidates.excerpt: A research partner for post-training data — not just an annotation platform.
observationCandidates.note: Candidate remains non-canonical until an exact locator is captured.

records.caveat: Formerly Start Carreiras (São Paulo, founded 2022; roughly $9.2M reported raised from Graphene Ventures, MAYA Capital, Norte Ventures, and Reach Capital). Sells RL environments, rubrics and verifiers, evaluation benchmarks, and expert data; the TRUSTED BY FRONTIER AI LABS banner names no customers and the DeepMind, Meta, and Mistral logos denote team pedigree, not clients. Distinct from vetto.dev and getvetto.com.
